criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 (src/harnesses/_core/object_gate) computed on the three PNGs in /tmp/fsrooms/gate-r3 and recorded per item; verdicts bind only to these hashes.
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: All three show top planes + front faces, no side/iso faces. Cold brazier keeps the lit kit's 3-row rim ellipse (grey rim row 0, ash/coal rows 1-2, grey lip row 3) - the same plane the lit kit fills with flame, so it reads in the same view; the advisory gate's 'front elevation' call is not upheld. Star lens: drum top ellipse ~12 rows over a ~11-row front face, lens shown as a tilted glass face in a yoke. Slit is a wall-mounted opening with a top-lit sill.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Palettes sit on v5 ramps: cold brazier uses the identical body/outline colours of tiles 6441/6442; slit stone jambs match the observatory wall greys and the brass band matches the poster frames; lens brass (4 steps + dark brown outline) matches v5 candelabra/frame brass, drum greys match marble statues. Multi-step shading, no flat fills. Sky dither bands in the slit are slightly mechanical but match the star-map posters.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: At 1x: brazier reads as an unlit iron brazier with ash next to the lit ones (clear on/off contrast for the puzzle); slit reads as a night-sky opening with moon rising through the roof; lens reads instantly as the room's centrepiece.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Slit's brass band sits on the ceiling ledge line (y=12..15 of the ceiling row) and the sill lands on the wall base, no clip; brazier occupies the foot tile exactly where 6442 sits; lens drum and dark translucent shadow (alpha 58/110) ground it on the sanctum floor, nothing floats.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Inspected at 12x: no stray pixels, stubs or holes. Outlines are near-black/dark brown consistent with neighbouring v5 art and the lit brazier kit.

items.name: 꺼진 화로(삼각대 쇠 화로, 숯·재) (cold brazier)
reasons: Same body, legs and outline as lit foot tile 6442; the rim ellipse (rows 0-3) is the same top plane the lit kit fills with flame, now ash + two dull embers - same 3/4 view, not a front elevation.
Side-by-side with mock-gate-lit at 1x and 6x the swap reads as 'the fire went out', which is what the four-braziers puzzle needs.
Near-black outline is inherited from the lit kit and matches it; changing it would make the swap pop.

items.name: 지붕까지 트인 관측 틈(2×3, 천장 1줄 + 벽면 2줄) (dome slit tall)
reasons: Brass band at y=12..15 replaces the ceiling ledge exactly and the darker ceiling-row jambs read as the slit continuing through the roof; wall-row jambs, shutters and top-lit sill match the wall face.
Sky ramp darkens upward with moon in the ceiling row - reads at 1x as a roof observation slit above the telescope.
Clean silhouette; minor note only: the horizontal checker dither rows at sky y=8-9, 20-21, 33-34 are a bit regular, acceptable since the v5 star posters use the same treatment.

items.name: 별 렌즈(옛 별지기의 큰 렌즈, 4×2) (star lens)
reasons: Stone drum has a lit top ellipse and a front face shaded light-left to dark-right with a brass foot ring; yoke arms meet in a brass knot sitting on the top plane - correct 3/4 stacking.
Brass ramp and gem-blue glass with a single star glint match v5 frames/crystal; shadow is dark translucent, grounding it on the sanctum floor.
Reads as the vault centrepiece at 1x without overpowering statues/candelabra; no stray pixels at 12x.
